9. Tidal mechanism: tentative future interest leaves it proposed; it is not an acceptance or a committed deferral decision (5bcfbb3c r1).

10. Floating bridge: hypothetical only (96dee911 r1). In the same period it would conflict with the accepted no-bridge rule (c70819f0 r1); that rule is unchanged. Timing and intent remain uncertain (c8ddb813 r1).

11. Weather: both alternatives are open again. The prior storm selection is retained in history; its current status is unresolved (ca5f921f r3; weather assertion 56d74b11 r2; revision decision 1f27742d r1). Clear weather remains unresolved and unselected (6b3bb4ae r1). Neither is rejected.
